# camera_android_camerax, vendored for MotoCam

Upstream: camera_android_camerax 0.7.2 from pub.dev (pub cache sha256 b5064cf25a2787d122d0bf12e77c7b1033a2b983d0730e3091f770ee376efde5), copied unchanged except that `example/` is left out. Used through `dependency_overrides` in the app's pubspec.yaml. Licence: LICENSE in this folder (BSD-style, The Flutter Authors).

Why vendored: two fixes found on the phone on 2026-11-11 need changes inside this plugin (details and evidence: MotoCam-audit-data/2026-10-20/device-run-2026-11-10/crash-and-roll-facts.md).

## Patches

1. Segment rolls keep VideoCapture bound (`lib/src/android_camera_camerax.dart`). New field `AndroidCameraCameraX.keepVideoCaptureBoundOnNextStop` (default false). When the app sets it right before `stopVideoRecording`, that one stop does not unbind VideoCapture, so the next `startVideoCapturing` finds it bound and skips the bind; CameraX then keeps its capture session and video encoder instead of rebuilding both. The stop reads and clears the flag first, whatever its outcome. Every other stop keeps the upstream behaviour (unbind). The app sets the flag only for timed segment rolls that restart at once (`lib/features/camera/providers/segment_roll_binding.dart`, called from `_cycleSegment(keepVideoStreamBound: true)` in `camera_provider.dart`); stall recovery and the final STOP keep the full rebuild. Side effect: when STOP lands during a roll (after the roll's stop, before its restart), VideoCapture stays bound but idle (not streaming) until the next START or until the camera is disposed. Also new: `unbindIdleVideoCapture()`, which the app calls before retrying a failed segment restart so the retry binds VideoCapture fresh (the upstream start); it does nothing while recording. The app clears the flag in a `finally` if its stop fails before reaching the plugin. Tests: five in `test/android_camera_camerax_test.dart`. Phone check: per-roll gap with 5 s or 10 s segments before and after, and no "Detaching [VideoCapture" or new CameraGraph at a roll.
2. Preview surfaces released before the engine detaches (`android/.../PreviewProxyApi.java` `releaseAllSurfaceProducers`, `ProxyApiRegistrar.java` `releasePreviewSurfaceProducers`, `CameraAndroidCameraxPlugin.java` `onDetachedFromEngine`). Releases every Flutter SurfaceProducer the plugin handed to a Preview while FlutterJNI is still attached (FlutterEngine.destroy detaches plugins before it detaches JNI). A camera frame still in flight then reaches a released producer, which closes the image and returns, instead of calling scheduleFrame on a detached engine (crash "FlutterJNI is not attached to native" when MotoCam was swiped from Recents while recording). Logs "Released N preview surface(s) on engine detach" (tag MotoCamCameraX). Tests: two in `android/src/test/.../PreviewTest.java`. Phone check: several Recents swipes while recording, no am_crash.

## Upgrading

When moving to a newer upstream version, copy the new release over this folder (leave out `example/`), reapply every patch listed above, run this package's tests (`flutter pub get` and `flutter test` in this folder) and the app's checks, and repeat the phone checks named in each patch.
